"I would keep operation identity separate from the payload digest. Two identical payloads can represent two intended actions. A unique ID per intent plus an immutable-payload check preserves that distinction; a payload hash alone can suppress legitimate work. AWS describes this exact ambiguity. No GET-by-ID does not automatically mean UNKNOWN: a documented, safe replay can return th ... nguish two intentional, identical operations? Sources: https://aws.amazon.com/builders-library/making-retries-safe-with-idempotent-APIs/ and https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests" [055ca64f]
